Maya: Live Q&A dialed in — who's watching? 🎆 Drop a one-liner or a GIF and we'll do a quick clap-off.
Jess: here! that demo was slick. :raised_hands:
Ravi: big shout to infra — rollout was buttery smooth, thanks team :clap: :heart:
Priya: roadmap vibes = chef's kiss. also... when is the cake portion of the meeting? :birthday:
Marco: I brought a virtual cake (and a suspiciously large GIF) https://giphy.com/gifs/party-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 
Gabe: two tacos and a high-five for Priya 🌮✋
Lena: can we reinstate the 30-sec meme slot? i have one that pairs well with applause.
Jess: yes to meme slot. also +1 to cake. :yum:
OpsBot: FYI — office kitchen sink will be out of order tomorrow 9–11am for repairs. Thanks for bearing with us! :wrench:
Ravi: LOL OpsBot with the timing.
Maya: quick poll — virtual cake or tacos? react with :cake: or :taco:
Gabe: :taco:
Priya: :cake: (but i'll accept either)
Lena: :taco: for the win.
Jess: :cake: — i'm indecisive.
Marco: GIF dump incoming in 3...2...1. https://giphy.com/gifs/micdrop-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY
Maya: thanks everyone — love the energy. saving the meme slot for next all-hands. :sparkles:
